Rae Kim: Hey team — Rae here (joining ML infra today!). Quick intro: ex-search infra at Quill, coffee snob, likes hiking. First day checklist q's below, thanks in advance! :wave:

Tess (People Ops): Welcome Rae!! :tada: Your MDM laptop is shipping today, ETA Wed. I'll DM tracking. If you need early access to repo, ping Ishaan.

Ishaan Reddy: welcome!! Can you confirm preferred OS? (mac/linux)

Rae Kim: macOS please. Also, is there a shortcut to get SSH keys set for prod? I tried following docs but hit a perms error.

Jordan Park: Hi Rae — for SSH, follow infra guide and run `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 && make auth` from ops-tooling. If perms error paste the error here and I'll poke perms.

Marta (IT): Badge queued. Do you need building access after-hours? If so say yes and which days.

Rae Kim: Yes please for Mon/Thu evenings for lab time. Also curious about team lunch — do we do a welcome lunch? I have strong feelings about pizza toppings (pineapple optional 😅)

Tess (People Ops): We do a welcome lunch Thu noon. Team vote in thread: pizza vs poke vs sandwiches. 

Ishaan Reddy: pizza :pizza: — extra olives

Jordan Park: sandwiches for me

Marta (IT): Added after-hours access, you'll get an email to confirm.

Rae Kim: One last fun fact: I once backpacked across Iceland and brought back way too many postcards. Happy to swap recs! :mountain:

Tess (People Ops): Love it. We'll set a 30-min intro on Thu with ML infra folks. Welcome again Rae! :sparkles:

welcome-bot: Rae Kim joined channel #new-hires
